slots.name: share price changes
slots.sentence: The news has weighed on health insurance shares. Centene (CNC.N), Molina (MOH.N) and Elevance (ELV.N) fell 1.5%, 6.5% and 4.2% in the week since the announcement while UnitedHealth (UNH.N) shares fell 2.6%.

slots.name: broker enrollment share
slots.sentence: Brokers bring in 75% of people enrolled in the marketplace, according to government data released in 2026.

slots.name: enrollees under review
slots.sentence: The government is also banning hundreds of brokers and will not accept new brokers, saying new brokers — who were paid a monthly fee for each enrollee — are often the ones who committed fraud.

slots.name: broker count
slots.sentence: There are 84,000 brokers nationwide who can help individuals pick a plan this year, according to the Department of Health and Human Services.

slots.name: 2027 premium rate status
slots.sentence: "The premium rates for 2027 have already been filed, and at this point, they've all been approved and locked down," said Matt McGough, a policy expert at health policy research firm KFF.
